conventions.definition: absolute or normalized charge and cell capacity
conventions.unit: C or Ah, but one timebase

conventions.definition: Li fraction x and delithiation fraction xbar=1-x
delithiation progress and occupied fraction theta=1-xi
Bernardi signed cell current, I>0 cell discharge
transition center and implicit equilibrium observation voltage
logistic voltage scale and dimensionless thermal multiplicity
background differential capacity and its unspecified primitive
pointwise temperature and representative mean used by selected paths
signed reversible heat into the declared cell control volume

cycle_analysis.closure: local only when F_U is nonzero; global branch selection conditional
requires declared dw/dT and differentiability; the path is a driver into the implicit charge cycle, not a second closed cycle
not closed for finite-window rest or mid-protocol reversal

assumptions: Ch1 sigma_d labels half-cell delithiation as discharge
Bernardi I>0 labels cell discharge and graphite lithiation

derivation_steps.statement: Map c-rate and Q_cell to current magnitude with one time unit
Remove ohmic polarization as V_n=V_app-sigma_d|I|R_n
Keep Bernardi signed I separate from sigma_d

derivation_checks.domain: half-cell and cell labels are separate coordinate layers
derivation_checks.result_rationale: Both formulae are internally usable, but the same word discharge denotes opposite graphite reaction directions.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: Ch1 sigma_d=+1 is graphite delithiation; Ch2 I>0 is cell discharge and graphite lithiation
derivation_checks.title: direction, voltage and current coordinate split

analytic_limits: Delta S=constant gives a linear center
assumptions: instantaneous Gibbs identity at fixed pressure

derivation_steps.statement: Use Delta G=Delta H-T Delta S
Use Delta G=-F U
Obtain U=(-Delta H+T Delta S)/F and dU/dT=Delta S/F for T-independent Delta S

derivation_checks.domain: thermodynamic state function; T-dependent Delta S requires integration
derivation_checks.result_rationale: The stated center law follows from the declared reaction convention.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: positive insertion Delta S raises the half-cell equilibrium center with T
derivation_checks.title: Gibbs reaction center and entropy slope

analytic_limits: V=U gives xi=1/2
integral over the full transition equals one

derivation_steps.statement: Write xi=logistic[sigma_d(V-Ud)/w]
Differentiate along the progress direction
Obtain the positive bell xi(1-xi)/w with height 1/(4w) and unit area

derivation_checks.result_rationale: Independent quadrature reproduces the positive magnitude, but the source silently relabels that magnitude as signed dQ/dV on charge.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: positive observation peak uses the progress-direction derivative; raw dxi/dV changes sign on charge
derivation_checks.title: logistic derivative, peak height and area

analytic_limits: xbar->0 and 1 approach endpoint roots

derivation_steps.statement: Define F(U;Qbar,T)=sum_j Q_j xi_j(U,T)-Q xbar
Solve F=0 for U
Feed the root back to every xi_j

derivation_checks.result_rationale: The four-transition source fixture has a bracketed monotone root and reproduces the worked point.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: xbar=1-x increases with delithiation and U on the branch-free logistic
derivation_checks.title: background-free implicit charge residual

analytic_limits: C_bg=0 closes the published Chapter 2 residual
assumptions: an integration reference for Q_bg is additionally required

derivation_steps.statement: Integrate the ICA identity to Q=Q_bg+sum Q_j xi_j
Observe that C_bg alone determines Q_bg only up to a constant
Compare with the Chapter 2 residual, which omits Q_bg

derivation_checks.domain: nonzero background requires a primitive and reference state
derivation_checks.result_rationale: The source does not define the background primitive or its charge offset for the implicit composition solve.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: no sign is fixed for an arbitrary background
derivation_checks.title: background primitive and integration constant

analytic_limits: (dU/dQ)(dQ/dU)=1
F_U->0 makes DVA singular
assumptions: target Q is an independent charge coordinate

derivation_steps.statement: Differentiate F(U,Q)=0 to F_U dU+F_Q dQ=0
Obtain dU/dQ=-F_Q/F_U
For F=sum Q_j xi_j-Q, F_Q=-1 and dU/dQ=1/F_U while dQ/dU=F_U

derivation_checks.result_rationale: Analytic and independent charge finite differences agree within tolerance.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: positive Q_j and w_j give F_U>0 on finite logistic states
derivation_checks.title: local dU/dQ and reciprocal ICA/DVA

analytic_limits: F_U=0 is a fold or plateau singular boundary
assumptions: the branch-free ideal-logistic special case is monotone
regular-solution and history branches may be nonmonotone

derivation_steps.statement: Show F_U=sum Q_j g_j>0 for positive ideal-logistic components
Note that this proves uniqueness only for that restricted branch
Retain plateau, multi-root, negative-background and history-dependent cases as unresolved

derivation_checks.domain: general source model with phase separation, background or history
derivation_checks.result_rationale: The worked bisection root does not prove uniqueness for every admitted model path.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: restricted ideal branch is increasing
derivation_checks.title: global root uniqueness and plateau/multiroot boundary

analytic_limits: constant n reduces to nR/F
assumptions: w=n(T)RT/F when n is the governing input
direct frozen w is a distinct branch

derivation_steps.statement: Differentiate w=n(T)RT/F
Obtain dw/dT=(R/F)(n+T dn/dT)
For the documented default n=1 obtain R/F, whereas frozen direct w gives zero

derivation_checks.domain: n-governed and direct-w branches must not be merged
derivation_checks.result_rationale: The no-n/no-w implementation has w=RT/F but reports dw/dT=0; the complete-input list also omits the required thermal-width state.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: positive constant n gives positive dw/dT
derivation_checks.title: temperature derivative of width

analytic_limits: gap=0 for Omega<=2RT
gap approaches zero from above as (Tc-T)^(3/2)
assumptions: Omega is T-independent in the displayed derivative
gamma and h_eta are empirical multipliers

derivation_steps.statement: Set g''=RT/[xi(1-xi)]-2Omega to zero
Obtain xi_s=(1+-sqrt(1-2RT/Omega))/2
Evaluate the spinodal voltage gap and multiply its half-gap by sigma_d gamma h_eta

derivation_checks.domain: Omega>2RT for a real spinodal; branch scale is phenomenological
derivation_checks.result_rationale: The algebraic spinodal result closes, but gamma*h_eta and the use of a spinodal upper bound as observed hysteresis are not independently derived.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: gap is nonnegative; discharge center is above charge under Ch1 labels
derivation_checks.title: regular-solution spinodal gap and empirical branch scale

analytic_limits: I->0 gives L_q,L_V->0 when all other factors remain finite
assumptions: c-rate is stated in inverse hours

derivation_steps.statement: Divide dxi/dt by dq/dt=|I|/Q_cell
Obtain L_q=(|I|/Q_cell)/k
Convert c-rate from h^-1 to s^-1 before combining with k in s^-1

derivation_checks.result_rationale: The source explicitly acknowledges a factor-3600 alternative while the runtime convention uses the unconverted numeric c-rate; the numerical seed lag is not dimensionally unique.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: L_q and L_V are nonnegative magnitudes
derivation_checks.title: lag length timebase closure

analytic_limits: kernel area is one
L_V->0 recovers the equilibrium bell

derivation_steps.statement: Solve the first-order lag equation with an integrating factor
Use the lower-past integral for discharge and upper-past integral for charge
Differentiate the lagged state to obtain a nonnegative peak and take L_V->0

derivation_checks.result_rationale: Independent discrete convolution confirms normalization, positivity, mirroring and the small-lag limit within discretization tolerance.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: charge is the voltage mirror of discharge when all other parameters are symmetric
derivation_checks.title: monotone causal convolution and small-lag limit

analytic_limits: infinite equilibrated prehistory removes the boundary term
assumptions: the displayed convolution extrapolates to an infinite past
rest has dq/dt=0 and cannot be parameterized by monotone q

derivation_steps.statement: Retain the finite-start boundary term r(q0) exp[-(q-q0)/Lq]
Observe that sending q0 to infinity discards initial state
A reversal or rest therefore needs explicit time/history state not present in the static sweep equations

derivation_checks.result_rationale: The source closes two separate monotone sweep directions, not a stateful rest/reversal/finite-window protocol.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: mid-protocol reversal changes the causal past but not merely the integration label
derivation_checks.title: rest, mid-protocol reversal and finite-window state

analytic_limits: single-transition limit gives dUj/dT+(dw/dT)z
frozen w removes the config-width term
assumptions: the width derivative is explicitly known

derivation_steps.statement: Differentiate the charge residual at fixed xbar
Separate center motion and width motion in partial xi/partial T
Divide by F_U to obtain the weighted simple or complete entropy coefficient

derivation_checks.result_rationale: The independent four-transition finite difference matches the complete expression only under w=RT/F; direct frozen width requires a different expression.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: config term sign follows z=ln[xi/(1-xi)]
derivation_checks.title: implicit thermal sensitivity and complete weighting

analytic_limits: T->0 gives S_vib->0
high T gives R[1+ln(T/theta_E)]

derivation_steps.statement: Differentiate the harmonic-mode free energy to obtain S_vib
Subtract the T_ref entropy
Integrate Delta S_vib/F from T_ref so Delta U and Delta S share one free energy

derivation_checks.domain: representative Einstein mode, not a phonon-DOS proof
derivation_checks.result_rationale: Independent free-energy finite differences reproduce Delta S_vib/F and the source's four illustrative slopes.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: Delta U and Delta S are exactly zero at T_ref
derivation_checks.title: Einstein entropy/free-energy round trip

analytic_limits: T->0 removes the leading electronic entropy
outside the gate sigma(1-sigma)->0
assumptions: g(E) is locally frozen near E_F
the logistic g(E_F,x) gate is a model assumption
one mole of relevant insertion sites is the molar basis

derivation_steps.statement: Convert states/eV/atom to states/J/atom by division by e_V and multiply by N_A
Differentiate the logistic DOS gate in insertion x
Integrate Delta S_e=a_e T so the center shift contains a_e(T^2-T_ref^2)/(2F)

derivation_checks.domain: metallic Sommerfeld endpoint plus empirical continuous composition gate
derivation_checks.result_rationale: The independent unit and T^2 round trip closes, but the reachable implementation freezes the electronic contribution at x_center and 298.15 K and therefore lacks the source T^2 path.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: insertion through the stated gate gives Delta S_e<0
derivation_checks.title: Sommerfeld unit conversion and T-squared center curvature

analytic_limits: I=0 gives zero heat rate
reversing I reverses the reversible term
assumptions: mixing enthalpy and explicit phase-change residuals are omitted as stated

derivation_steps.statement: Use Delta G=-F U to obtain Delta S=F dU/dT
Insert it into qdot_rev=-IT dU/dT
Map electrode and full-cell signs only after defining the voltage difference

derivation_checks.result_rationale: The numerical worked sign is reproduced, but half-cell/full-cell and Ch1 direction labels require an explicit assembly map.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: I>0 and dU/dT<0 gives positive heat under the stated cell convention
derivation_checks.title: electrode entropy and reversible heat sign

analytic_limits: Delta U_hys->0 makes the branch average equal the branch-free value
assumptions: charge and discharge branches sample comparable states
exact cancellation is only linearized for gap much smaller than width

derivation_steps.statement: Compute each branch's weighted dU/dT
Average branch coefficients for the reversible estimate
Keep I Delta U_hys as a separate irreversible dissipation channel

derivation_checks.result_rationale: The source states a linearized branch-average rule, while no explicit reachable branch-average implementation exists.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: the gap magnitude dissipates positive cycle energy
derivation_checks.title: reversible branch average versus hysteresis dissipation

assumptions: both electrodes use the same insertion-reaction Gibbs sign
electrode direction labels are mapped separately

derivation_steps.statement: Derive each electrode center from its own reaction inputs
Apply electrode-specific electronic and direction extensions
Compose full-cell voltage or heat only after subtracting electrode potentials under one convention

derivation_checks.result_rationale: The half-cell forms are separable; the v1.0.19 source does not close the final full-cell composition path.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: full-cell voltage is cathode minus anode under the usual assembly convention, but final assembly is outside this source scope
derivation_checks.title: Graphite and LCO observation-path separation

analytic_limits: I->0 removes kinetic lag but not intrinsic or ensemble width
assumptions: intrinsic, kinetic and ensemble broadening are distinct mechanisms

derivation_steps.statement: Keep the equilibrium logistic scale separate from causal lag
Treat apparent-U heterogeneity as a forward ensemble average
Do not infer a unique mechanism or inverse distribution from a single observed width

derivation_checks.result_rationale: No production ensemble calculator or source-grounded inverse-identification law closes the width budget.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: broadening magnitudes are nonnegative but not simply signed additive physics parameters
derivation_checks.title: equilibrium, lag and ensemble width authority

assumptions: Phase 071 has not verified cited primary sources

derivation_steps.statement: Separate source-cited endpoint or trend from transition-specific numbers
Mark fit initializations and model gates independently
Do not convert a runtime match into material authority

derivation_checks.result_rationale: Several numbers are explicitly fit-only or ground-not-found; cited items remain source-cited-unverified until Phase 071.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: not applicable
derivation_checks.title: material-number authority boundary

assumptions: only the displayed observation operators are available

derivation_steps.statement: Factor each observation into parameter combinations
Identify transformations that preserve the same curve at fixed protocol
Require additional temperatures, rates, directions or independent measurements to break each symmetry

derivation_checks.result_rationale: Single-condition curves identify combinations such as L_V, gamma*h_eta*gap, and gmax/delta_x rather than every primitive parameter.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: not applicable
derivation_checks.title: structurally inseparable parameter combinations

analytic_limits: gamma->0 or gap->0 restores a direction-invariant baseline
assumptions: gamma may remain nonzero as current tends to zero
hysteresis and kinetic lag are distinct

derivation_steps.statement: Take I to zero in the branch-center equation
Retain the sigma_d gamma h_eta gap term when gamma is nonzero
Compare the resulting direction-dependent center with the input section's direction-invariant zero-current baseline

derivation_checks.domain: zero-current limit with an active hysteresis branch
derivation_checks.result_rationale: Two source sections make incompatible zero-current claims unless an unstated gamma->0 condition is imposed.
derivation_checks.sign_convention: nonzero thermodynamic branch shift remains direction-odd even when current-dependent polarization and lag vanish
derivation_checks.title: zero-current hysteresis baseline authority

findings.disposition: Step 45.1 preserve as conditional; Phase 075/076 must close branch selection.
findings.statement: The worked monotone bisection does not prove a unique root for admitted plateau, phase-separated, background, or history-dependent paths.

findings.disposition: Step 45.1 CORRECT route; retain Step 43 MISALIGNED finding.
findings.statement: The default thermal width is RT/F but the implementation derivative is zero, and the complete-expression input list omits n(T) or dw/dT.

findings.disposition: Step 45.1 CORRECT/NEW_SCOPE route; Phase 076 state equation.
findings.statement: The static monotone convolution has no explicit state for rest, finite-window initialization, or mid-protocol reversal.

findings.disposition: Step 45.1 CORRECT route; Phase 078 evidence-gated LCO closure.
findings.statement: The source's LCO electronic entropy requires x,V,T dependence and T-squared center curvature, whereas the reachable path freezes x_center and 298.15 K.

findings.disposition: Step 45.1 THEORY_ONLY/CORRECT route; Phase 081 heat closure.
findings.statement: The reversible charge/discharge branch-average path is absent and the source identity is exact only to linear order in a small hysteresis gap.

findings.disposition: Step 45.1 preserve as sign blocker; Phase 074/081.
findings.statement: Ch1 half-cell discharge and Bernardi cell discharge are opposite graphite reaction directions; electrode/full-cell heat signs need an explicit map.

findings.disposition: Keep UNVERIFIED; Phase 071/072 authority and data gates.
findings.statement: Transition-specific Graphite kinetic/interaction numbers and continuous LCO gate parameters lack primary-source authority or are explicitly fit-only.

findings.disposition: Step 45.1 THEORY_ONLY/NEW_SCOPE; Phase 077/081.
findings.statement: The three broadening mechanisms are not closed by a forward ensemble calculator or identifiable inverse law.

findings.disposition: Step 45.1 CORRECT route; freeze separate signed-derivative and positive-magnitude observables.
findings.statement: The source uses dQ/dV for both the signed derivative of a progress-increasing charge coordinate and its positive ICA magnitude, which disagree on charge.

findings.disposition: Step 45.1 source-conflict route; do not promote either baseline as canonical before resolution.
findings.statement: The source says nonzero hysteresis survives I->0 in one section but declares the zero-current baseline direction-invariant in another without gamma->0.

findings.disposition: Identifiability carry-forward.
findings.statement: Only gamma*h_eta*DeltaU_hys is observed in the branch shift; its factors are not separately identified.

findings.disposition: Multi-rate/multi-temperature carry-forward.
findings.statement: A direct L_V bypass and the kinetic product cannot identify dH_a, dS_a, chi, Omega and dV/dq separately at one condition.

findings.disposition: Require multi-temperature center data.
findings.statement: At one temperature, Delta H and Delta S enter the center only through -DeltaH+TDeltaS.

findings.disposition: Require an absolute charge/reference-state contract.
findings.statement: Capacity scaling and an unfixed background-charge offset can trade against composition normalization.

findings.disposition: Phase 081 experimental design.
findings.statement: Two temperatures constrain only a local slope; Einstein curvature and a linear electronic term need at least three informative temperatures.

findings.disposition: Phase 071/072/078 carry-forward.
findings.statement: At the LCO gate center, amplitude is proportional to gmax/delta_x; endpoint and width evidence are needed to separate them.

findings.disposition: Preserve singular-domain diagnostics.
findings.statement: ICA/DVA reciprocity is local and fails as a finite number when F_U approaches zero.

findings.disposition: Correct the future input contract before adoption.
findings.statement: The source's complete synthesis lists w but consumes n or dw/dT, so arbitrary direct-width thermal behavior is under-specified.

identifiability.required_evidence: three or more calibrated temperatures or independent calorimetry
full-cycle and partial-cycle bidirectional data over temperature
multi-rate, multi-temperature and independent OCV slope
independent endpoint DOS plus composition-resolved transition data

identifiability.combination: local temperature slope over two points
identifiability.required_evidence: at least three temperatures spanning useful curvature

source_conflicts.statement: Ch1 half-cell discharge is graphite delithiation, while Bernardi I>0 cell discharge is graphite lithiation.
Chapter 2 implicit charge uses xbar=1-x while other discussion often uses Li fraction x.
n-governed thermal width and directly specified frozen width imply different dw/dT.
ICA defines C_bg but the composition residual omits a referenced Q_bg primitive.
Some paths use pointwise T(V), while branch and lag quantities use T_rep.
Half-cell entropy coefficients require an explicit sign map before full-cell heat composition.
C-rate in h^-1 is numerically combined with Eyring kinetics in s^-1 in the reported seed estimate.
Source theory requires an integral/T-squared path, while current implementation freezes the electronic term at T_ref.
The source denotes both the signed charge derivative and its positive progress-direction magnitude by dQ/dV.
One source section retains gamma-scaled hysteresis at zero current while another declares a direction-invariant zero-current baseline.
